name: Surviving Purge
source:
Surviving Purge is a gay (bara) Tower Defence in which you play as an inferior human fighting to survive amongst other races from different galaxies!

[From [url=https://grizzly-gamer-studio.itch.io/surviving-purge-gay-bara-tower-defense]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Surviving Purge》是一款男同性戀壯男題材的塔防遊戲。你將扮演一個處於劣勢的人類，在來自不同星系的諸多種族之間為生存而戰！
